integrity: The first-failure and chamber statements are proved analytically from Webster priority inequalities. An exact-rational verifier replays sequential priorities, divisor intervals, finite predecessor grids, witness minimality, and the probability integral.
scientific_limitations: Pure apportionment with positive shares, no minimum-seat rule, and a strict Webster cutoff. The probability uses normalized Lebesgue measure on the four-entity simplex.
title: Sharp first quota failure of Webster apportionment
